column7: 2026-11-04: Encoding for inject(): plain encodeURIComponent does NOT match the storage service's signed path (it leaves ! ' ( ) * raw; service signs %21 %27 %28 %29). Adding .replace(/[!'()*]/g, c => '%'+c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()) matched the one logged example; * and non-ASCII unverified. User is undecided whether encoding belongs in regexparam (opt-in option) or in their uploader client; do not change inject() encoding until they decide.

2026-11-04: inject() now treats numeric 0 as a value (src/index.js, tests added in test/inject.js); false/NaN still count as missing. 'npm test' (uvu -r esm) crashes on this Node version even without changes (esm loader: 'Cannot use import statement outside a module'), so tests were verified by calling inject() directly.

2026-11-04: inject() now percent-encodes values (user asked 2026-11-04): encodeURIComponent + %21 %27 %28 %29 %2A for !'()*; wildcard '*' value split on '/', each segment encoded, slashes kept. Chosen to match storage service signing; * and non-ASCII still unverified against service. Tests added in test/inject.js; verified by calling inject() directly (uvu -r esm still crashes).
